params._settings: // Determines which exchange adapter is used to execute the trade through the TradeModule contract.
params._tradeModule: // The tradeModule contract. Used to trade the absorbed rETH2 into sETH2.

params._status: Boolean indicating whether to allow anyone call

devdoc.title: StakeWiseReinvestmentExtension

initialize().notice: Initializes the extension by: 1. Calling initialize on the AirdropModule for the SetToken with required airdrop settings. 2. Initializing the TradeModule for the SetToken to allow trading trading with the SetToken.

reinvest(uint256).notice: 1. Absorbs rETH2 into the SetToken 2. Trades rETH2 into sETH2 with _minReceivedQuantity  We considered removing the _minReceivedQuantity parameter and storing the slippage parameter as part of ExecutionSettings. However, in the event of a black swan event where rETH2 de-pegs, we'd need to updateExecutionSettings which would involve a multi-sig txn. Once rETH2 can be redeemed for sETH2 directly, the exchange rate is guaranteed to be at least 1:1. Therefore, _minReceiveQuantity can be removed and this function can be made public.

updateAnyoneCallable(bool).notice: OPERATOR ONLY: Toggle whether anyone can call function, bypassing the callAllowlist

updateCallerStatus(address[],bool[]).notice: OPERATOR ONLY: Toggle ability for passed addresses to call only allowed caller functions
